text:
maya: Heads-up — `batcher_delay_high` went noisy during the nightly load test. Lots of short blips. Where do folks usually pull traces/span ids for this?

arjun: Dash: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/batcher-delay and traces at https://tracing.redwood.ai (you need the trace id from logs).

sam: We should probably debounce or reduce cardinality. Current rule is p95 > 300ms over 5m and it's firing on test bursts.

maya: Can someone paste the exact alert expr? Want to propose a tweak instead of blanket muting.

lia: Current Prom rule I see in alerts repo: `alert: BatcherDelayHigh
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batcher_delay_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, instance)) > 0.3
for: 5m`

arjun: Two options: increase the eval window to 10m, or add a composite condition (p95>300ms AND error_rate>1%). Composite avoids hiding perf regressions that coincide with errors.

sam: Also we have the nightly load test schedule 00:00-01:00 UTC. Rather than changing rule globally, we can auto-snooze alerts for that window or add a suppression rule tied to the `job=test-load` label.

maya: I prefer not to silent it fully. Proposal: add debounce/backoff — require 2 consecutive evals over 10m OR p95>500ms. That keeps sensitivity to real regressions.

lia: If we go for snooze: alerts API supports a scheduled snooze, e.g. `snooze:batcher_delay_high:start=1748802000:duration=3600`. alerts-bot can apply it.

alerts-bot: Detected request. I can create a temporary snooze if you confirm the parameters. Reply with `confirm:snooze batcher_delay_high 3600`.

arjun: I’ll open a quick PR with two changes: increase window to 10m + add `or histogram_quantile(0.95, ...) > 0.5` clause for hard threshold. Link PR here when ready.

sam: I'll apply a 60m snooze for tonight scoped to label `job=test-load` so production traffic still alerts.

lia: Quick note on finding traces: run `kubectl logs -l app=batcher -n prod | grep trace=` — you should see `trace_id=` and `span_id=` in the lines. Example log line: `batcher.go: trace_id=deadbeef span_id=abcd1234 delay=345ms`

maya: perfect, thx. Action items: arjun -> PR for rule change; sam -> apply scoped snooze; lia -> add trace/findings to runbook and add grep snippet; i'll verify dashboard alerts tomorrow morning.

arjun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/634 (WIP)

sam: Snooze applied (scoped to job=test-load for 60m). alerts-bot: please post confirmation.

alerts-bot: Snooze created: `snooze/batcher_delay_high/1748802000/3600` (scoped label: job=test-load).

maya: thanks team — will follow up tomorrow. If anyone sees persistent noise outside the window ping here. :thumbsup:
